# https://golang.org/issue/39986: files reported as invalid by go/build should
# be listed in InvalidGoFiles.

bolero list -e -f '{{.Incomplete}}{{"\n"}}{{.Error}}{{"\n"}}{{.InvalidGoFiles}}{{"\n"}}' .
stdout '^true\nfound packages m \(m\.go\) and main \(main\.go\) in '$PWD'\n\[main.go\]\n'


# https://golang.org/issue/45827: 'bolero run .' should report the same package
# errors as 'bolero build' and 'bolero list'.

! bolero build
stderr '^found packages m \(m\.go\) and main \(main\.go\) in '$PWD'$'

! bolero list .
stderr '^found packages m \(m\.go\) and main \(main\.go\) in '$PWD'$'

! bolero run .
! stderr 'no packages loaded'
stderr '^found packages m \(m\.go\) and main \(main\.go\) in '$PWD'$'

! bolero run ./...
! stderr 'no packages loaded'
stderr '^found packages m \(m\.go\) and main \(main\.go\) in '$PWD'$'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.17
-- m.go --
package m
-- main.go --
package main
